maple.name: Maple
inside: Welcome in! Seeds on the left, bread by the door, gossip's free.
Gideon says my prices are robbery. Gideon charges me forty for a nail. Forty.
Don't lean on the glass case, dear.

perks.2: 5% off at the Mercantile
perks.4: 10% off; Maple stocks rare seeds
perks.6: Maple sends a seed pack each season
perks.8: 20% off at the Mercantile
perks.10: Maple's best row in the shop: 3 Growth Elixirs

gideon.name: Gideon
inside: Iron. Steel. Don't touch the forge.
Bring me ore and I'll make you something that doesn't bend.
Bring me bars and I'll show you what an edge is.

perks.2: Tool upgrades 10% cheaper
perks.4: Tool upgrades 20% cheaper
perks.6: Gideon's practice ring (the eleventh-year one didn't come out right): a Copper Ring
perks.8: Upgrades 30% cheaper
perks.10: Gideon's nail-loop thank-you, and his last lesson: +20 max health

wren.name: Wren
inside: Careful, that one bites. The purple one. No, the OTHER purple one.
Red for hurts, tea for tired. Say it back to me.
The crystal talks to you? Interesting. Does it talk to anyone else?

perks.2: Potions heal 25% more
perks.4: Wren leaves Energy Tea on your step each week
perks.6: Wren brews you a free potion each week
perks.8: Potions heal 50% more
perks.10: Wren teaches you to hold more magic: +20 max mana

inside_gangsters: Careful, that one bites. The purple one. No, the OTHER purple one.
Red for hurts, tea for tired. Say it back to me.
Don't ask what's in the black bottles. I won't ask what's in your pockets.

alder.name: Mayor Alder
inside: Have a seat, have a seat. Mind the papers. Those are important. Probably.
The town's doing well. The town is always doing well. That's my job.
If you need the board, the board meets when I say it meets.

perks.2: Town records: the mayor sends a Map Scrap
perks.4: Permits and buildings 20% cheaper
perks.6: A building grant: ◆500 toward your next plans
perks.8: Alder lends you the town cart (sell box pays 10% more)
perks.10: Keys to the city: ◆500 from the town purse

perks.2: Sal tells you where the loot is: a Map Scrap and a Luck Potion
perks.4: Sal teaches you to walk quiet: enemies notice you later
perks.6: Sal's spare kit: 2 Greater Potions
perks.8: Sal's contacts slip you ◆300
perks.10: Sal's old charm: a Dream Charm

perks.2: Fish bite 10% sooner
perks.4: Finn's bait is free: 10 Bait every week
perks.6: Finn's secret spot: a Luck Potion for the big ones
perks.8: +10% chance of a rare fish
perks.10: Finn's lucky tin: 3 Luck Potions

perks.2: Lumi gives you paints for your sign
perks.4: Lumi sells you paints at cost: 3 Paint each week
perks.6: Lumi's first sketch of you, pinned by the studio window: +10 max energy
perks.8: Lumi teaches you to see: +10 max energy, and a keepsake for your home: Painter's Easel
perks.10: Lumi's gate painting, with your face in it: a Dream Charm

theo.name: Theo
inside: Shh. Well, not shh. But quietly.
There's a book here about the valley that nobody's finished. Chapter one is enough to keep you up.

inside.text: Lumi draws in the margins. I pretend not to notice.
Lumi's sketchbook is still on the returns desk. I haven't shelved it. She'll want it back.

perks.2: +5% skill XP
perks.4: Theo lends you books: +10% skill XP
perks.6: Theo reads you the miners' log: 2 Memory Teas
perks.8: +15% skill XP
perks.10: Theo's thesis: one free skill point in every tree

perks.2: Hazel shares seeds: a seed pack each week
perks.4: Hazel waters your crops every other day
perks.6: Hazel waters your crops every day
perks.8: Hazel harvests ripe crops into your sell box
perks.10: Hazel's heirloom seeds: 5 Dream Seeds, the lumpy cheese, and Saffron, her golden hen, comes to your coop (she waits with Hazel until the coop has room)

bram.name: Bram
inside: Stew's on. Sit anywhere that isn't the mayor's chair.
Heard a story about a farmer and a crystal. Didn't believe it. Then you walked in.
Rooms upstairs if the walk home's too long. First night's free, second night's a pie.

perks.2: Bram's breakfast: a Tea each week
perks.4: Free soup at the inn: +30 energy once a day
perks.6: Bram's pies: 2 Orchard Pies
perks.8: Bram's stories: a Map Scrap
perks.10: Bram names a dish after you (+25 max energy)

inside_gangsters: Stew's on. Sit anywhere that isn't the mayor's chair.
Heard a story about a farmer who doesn't scare. Didn't believe it. Then you walked in.
Rooms upstairs if the walk home's too long. First night's free, second night's a pie.

posy.name: Posy
inside: Fresh out of the oven! Mind your fingers.
Bring me wheat and I'll bring you bread. Bring me strawberries and I'll bring you cake.

inside.text: Maple says you're clearing that old field. Good. Somebody should.
Maple says your fields look better than hers now. Don't tell her I told you.

perks.2: A free loaf every morning
perks.4: Posy bakes for you: a Berry Pie each week
perks.6: Posy's recipes: 2 Cakes, and Crumpet, her silver rabbit, moves into your hutch (she waits at the bakery until you have a hutch with room)
perks.8: Festival cake: +20 max energy
perks.10: Posy's best: two berry pies each week

juniper.name: Juniper
inside: Sit. Let me look at that.
You've been swinging that {weapon} in the meadow, haven't you. I can always tell.
Eat something green once in a while. I mean it.

perks.2: Clinic fee halved
perks.4: Juniper's tonic: +20 max health
perks.6: Clinic fee waived
perks.8: Juniper visits: wake with full energy after a collapse
perks.10: Juniper teaches Second Wind: +30 max health

rook.name: Rook
inside: Tracks by the stream. Big ones.
Don't go in the forest after dark without a lantern. Or do. I'll come and find you in the morning.

perks.2: Rook shows you the brambles: a Shed Fur each week
perks.4: Rook sells arrows and bramble brushes
perks.6: Rook's map of the quarry path: a Map Scrap
perks.8: Rook's field kit: 2 Greater Potions, and a keepsake for your home: Log Seat
perks.10: Rook's lucky arrowhead: a Light Charm

pip.name: Pip
lines: I'm not allowed in the forest. Are you?

perks.2: Pip finds you loose change: ◆20 each week
perks.4: Pip's treasure map: a Map Scrap
perks.6: Pip's secret: the fountain wish works (a Luck Potion)
perks.8: Pip's gang brings shells and arcade tickets: 3 shells, 10 tickets a week
perks.10: Pip's lucky charm

wren_jr.name: Wren jr
lines: I'm not allowed in the forest. Are you?

perks.2: Wren jr shares forage spots: a Tea Leaf each week
perks.4: A frog friend (it eats the bugs: +10 max energy)
perks.6: Wren jr's garden: a seed pack each week
perks.8: Wren jr's potion lesson: 2 Mana Potions
perks.10: Wren jr's wish: 2 Wishfruit

tobin.name: Tobin
lines: I'm not allowed in the forest. Are you?

perks.2: Tobin trades shells and arcade tickets: 3 shells, 5 tickets a week
perks.4: Tobin's beach map: a Map Scrap
perks.6: Tobin's kite day: +10 max energy
perks.8: Tobin's crew finds you ◆30 a week
perks.10: Tobin's compass: a Light Charm

mabel.name: Mabel
lines: I'm not allowed in the forest. Are you?

perks.2: Mabel shares a secret: a Memory Tea
perks.4: Mabel's flower crown: +10 max energy
perks.6: Mabel's songs: +10 max mana
perks.8: Mabel's diary: a Herbal Tea each week
perks.10: Mabel's wish: a Wonder Elixir

perks.2: Marlowe sells you lamp oil: 2 each week
perks.4: Marlowe's charts: a Luck Potion
perks.6: Night fishing at the lighthouse: 10 Bait each week
perks.8: Marlowe's new lens shows the east: a Moonlight Elixir, and a keepsake for your home: Echo Shell
perks.10: Marlowe's old tackle box: 3 Luck Potions

perks.2: Orla's spare flour: 3 each week
perks.4: Orla's spare wheat seed: 5 each week
perks.6: Orla's cornmeal: 3 each week
perks.8: The mill works for you: 5 Flour each week, and a keepsake for your home: Bread Oven
perks.10: Orla's heirloom grain: 5 Dream Seeds

perks.2: Horses half price
perks.4: Benno's saddle care: your horse runs 10% faster
perks.6: Benno's oats: +10 max energy
perks.8: Benno's spare tack sells for ◆250, and Tinker, a goat kid he hand-reared, comes to your barn (when it has room)
perks.10: Benno's feed run: 6 Hay each week for your animals

perks.2: Savings account: 1% interest
perks.4: Ivy's small loan you never have to pay back: ◆400
perks.6: 2% interest
perks.8: The account Ivy opened in your name pays your clinic fee when you collapse
perks.10: Ivy's vault: a Sapphire each week

perks.2: Tam's wool: 2 each week
perks.4: The Dollys find forage on the hill: 2 Tea Leaves each week
perks.6: Tam gives you a lamb's worth of wool: 5 Wool
perks.8: Tam's lamb Bramble moves into your barn, and 2 Cider each week, and a keepsake for your home: Braided Rug
perks.10: Tam's hills: 2 Golden Apples

perks.2: Moss shows safe paths: marsh wisps leave you be
perks.4: Bog iron: 3 each week
perks.6: Moss's lantern: the marsh fog lifts near you
perks.8: Marsh gas jars: 2 each week, and a keepsake for your home: Ivy Bookcase
perks.10: Moss's secret: a Growth Elixir each week

perks.2: Granite's crew drops off stone: 10 each week
perks.4: Granite sells dynamite at cost: 2 each week
perks.6: Granite's spare ore: 5 Copper each week
perks.8: Granite's crew clears rockslides: 3 Dynamite, and a keepsake for your home: Indoor Fire Bowl
perks.10: The deep quarry: 2 Sapphires

perks.2: Sel reads the first rune: a Memory Tea
perks.4: +10 max mana
perks.6: Sel opens the stone door: 2 Mana Potions
perks.8: Sel's translation: +10 max mana, and a keepsake for your home: Books and Scrolls
perks.10: Sel's rubbing of the wall: +20 max mana

catkins.name: Catkins
lines: Heart at the chest. Hearts and paws. Remember.
The cats say hello. Your dog is not impressed; dogs never are.

perks.2: Catkins' first meditation: +10 max energy
perks.4: Catkins' four coats: +10 max mana
perks.6: Cat-topia's pantry: 2 Tuna each week
perks.8: A guardian's patience: +20 max mana, and a keepsake for your home: Golden Lucky Cat
perks.10: Catkins' monastery blessing: +20 max health

tess.name: Tess
inside: Measure twice, cut once. Then sand it till it purrs.
Every chair in this town has a wobble I know by name.
Bring me a room and a budget. I'll bring the rest.

perks.2: Tess saves you offcuts: 5 Wood each week
perks.4: Tess's spare planks: 10 Planks
perks.6: Tess sends hardwood: 3 Hardwood each week
perks.10: Tess's master joinery: 10 Hardwood
perks.8: Tess gives you a keepsake for your home: Window Seat
